summary: Frontend-only retest of the iteration 5 empty-state fixes and the sidebar header. Owner with 0 companies: the sidebar has 40 links (39 unique hrefs, because Azienda and Vista di gruppo both point to '/'). On all 35 gated pages, the 'Crea prima la tua azienda' Empty state shows with data-testid no-company-create-btn. '/', /notifiche, /guida and /impostazioni render normally. /gruppo/consolidato and /gruppo/confronto show no spinner, and /utenti shows no 'Accesso non consentito'. Clicking the button on /gruppo/consolidato and /export goes to /impostazioni and opens the 'Nuova azienda' modal. The sidebar header shows the logo (36px) next to 'Nureal' (bold, 24px line) and 'Amministrazione' (12px line) on 2 tidy lines, with the bell aligned. This holds on desktop and in the 390x844 mobile drawer. The mobile top bar shows the logo plus 'Nureal-Amministrazione' on one line, which fits. After creating TEST_Alpha Srl through the empty-state CTA, the sidebar has 40 unique links, and all of them render real content: no CTA, no 'Accesso non consentito', no stuck 'Caricamento', no pageerrors and no API 4xx/5xx. The login app-logo is visible (naturalWidth 512).
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js: the 0-company gate sits in Layout, so each page component isn't mounted and makes no failing API calls. Good approach.

Settings.js reads ?nuova=1 only in the useState initializer. This works because Settings mounts fresh, but it would not reopen the modal if the user were already on /impostazioni. The CTA is hidden there, so this is harmless today.
The login inputs still have no data-testid
